description.en: Desktop notifications for DeepSeek Harness: a system banner when a turn finishes or the agent waits for your choice, a click to return to that conversation, and unread ones counted on the app icon.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的桌面通知：回合结束或智能体等你选择时弹一条系统通知，点击回到对应会话，没点开的计入应用图标角标。

description.en: Watches a long session for the two moments that need you and raises one system notification for each: the turn finished, and the agent starting to wait for your choice. The body is the conversation name and the state, and a click opens that conversation. Unopened notifications are counted on the app icon (a Dock badge on macOS, a taskbar overlay on Windows) and the count clears when you come back; subagent conversations stay quiet. A pure client bundle: no dependencies, no build step, no network requests, nothing written to disk. Needs DSH desktop 0.2.2-rc.3 or newer; notifications come from the open page, so a closed window is silent.
description.zh: 盯住长会话里真正需要你的两个时刻，各弹一条系统通知：回合结束，以及智能体开始等你做选择。正文是会话名与状态，点一下通知就回到那个会话。没点开的通知会计到应用图标上（macOS Dock 角标、Windows 任务栏覆盖），回到窗口即清零；子智能体会话保持安静。纯客户端插件：无依赖、无构建、不联网、不写磁盘。需要 DSH 桌面版 0.2.2-rc.3 及以上；通知由已打开的页面发出，关掉窗口就不再提醒。
